home.title:
Four steps.
Hold the ground.
home.intro: A turn is a small plan: move, protect, displace, or make a goal. Learn the rules of Arimaa, then play the whole field.
home.signature: One turn · up to four steps · four trap squares
home.diagramCaption: Read the traps. Watch the edges.

setup.title: Set up a game
setup.intro: Gold places first. Each player arranges a full army on their own two home ranks.
setup.botHint: Six fixed-budget levels. Setup is chosen by each side.
setup.localHint: Two people, one device. Take turns after setup.
setup.firstTurn: Gold places first and moves first. The bot places its own army.
setup.localNote: Gold places first. Pass the device when setup changes sides, and after each turn.
setup.setupHint: Select a piece, then place it on either of your two home ranks.

game.chooseAction: Choose how to use this first step
game.noMoves: Your complete turns will appear here.
game.quickRuleText: A turn must change the position. Pushes and pulls are paired two-step actions; trap captures happen after each step.
game.repeatBlocked: That position would be a third occurrence. Add a legal action or undo the draft.
game.resultImmobile: The opponent has no legal turn.
game.resultRepetition: Every available turn would repeat a position for the third time.

rabbit.name: Rabbit
rabbit.description: A gentle first opponent. It explores a small set of turns.

cat.name: Cat
cat.description: Looks for nearby gains and safe routes.

dog.name: Dog
dog.description: Keeps more pieces in view and watches the traps.

camel.name: Camel
camel.description: Values space, support, and advancing Rabbits.

elephant.name: Elephant
elephant.description: The strongest fixed-budget opponent in this edition.

tutorial.title: Learn the field
tutorial.intro: Short exercises teach the selected rules. Each move is checked by the same engine used in a game.
tutorial.correct: Correct. The rule is now on the board.
tutorial.wrong: That move is legal, but it does not demonstrate this rule. Try again.
tutorial.illegal: The rules engine rejected that turn. Review the legal actions and try again.
tutorial.quizPrompt: Choose the result the rules engine gives this position.
tutorial.boardTask: Make the marked idea happen on the board.

setup.title: Choose a formation
setup.summary: Place the full army on the two home ranks; Gold sets up first.
setup.task: Place an Elephant on one of Gold's two home ranks.

orthogonal.title: Step one square orthogonally
orthogonal.summary: Pieces move one square north, south, east, or west, never diagonally.
orthogonal.task: Move the Dog one square to the right.

steps.title: Spend up to four steps
steps.summary: A turn can be shorter than four steps, but it must change the position.
steps.task: Move the Rabbit four squares forward in one complete turn.

rabbit.title: Rabbits only advance
rabbit.summary: A Rabbit cannot step backward under its own power.
rabbit.task: Advance the Gold Rabbit one square toward rank eight.

freeze.title: Break a freeze
freeze.summary: A stronger enemy freezes a piece unless a friendly piece stands beside it.
freeze.task: Move the Cat beside the frozen Rabbit to give it support.

push.title: Push as a pair
push.summary: Move the weaker enemy first, then the stronger piece into the space it left.
push.task: Push the Silver Rabbit with the Gold Elephant. This paired action uses two steps.

pull.title: Pull as a pair
pull.summary: Move your stronger piece first, then pull the weaker enemy into the vacated square.
pull.task: Pull the Silver Rabbit with the Gold Elephant. Keep both steps together.

trap.title: Traps resolve after every step
trap.summary: A piece on c3, f3, c6, or f6 is captured as soon as it has no friendly neighbor.
trap.task: Move the Cat away and leave the unsupported Rabbit on c3.

support.title: Keep a trap supported
support.summary: One adjacent friendly piece is enough to keep a piece on a trap alive.
support.task: Move the Gold Rabbit to the goal rank; notice that the supported trap piece survives.

goal.title: Reach the goal
goal.summary: A Rabbit on the far rank at the end of its move wins.
goal.task: Move the Gold Rabbit onto rank eight.

elimination.title: Capture every Rabbit
elimination.summary: Capturing all opposing Rabbits is a win even if other enemy pieces remain.
elimination.task: Read the result for this position.

immobilization.title: Leave no legal turn
immobilization.summary: A player with no legal turn loses. Frozen pieces cannot move themselves.
immobilization.task: Read the result for this frozen position.

repetition.title: No third occurrence
repetition.summary: A side cannot complete a turn that makes the same position with the same player to move occur a third time.
repetition.task: Can Silver return the Elephant to f4 now?

noPass.title: A turn must change the position
noPass.summary: Every turn must change the board. Moving out and back to the same position is not a pass loophole.
noPass.task: Choose whether the Elephant may step away and return in the same turn.

priority.title: Resolve the result order
priority.summary: If results overlap, the player who just moved is checked first for a goal Rabbit.
priority.task: Read which side wins when both goal ranks are occupied.

quiz.goldGoal: The Rabbit that just moved wins first
quiz.noTurn: The side with no legal turn loses
quiz.eliminated: The side with no Rabbits loses
quiz.repeatBlocked: No, this would be a third occurrence
quiz.passAllowed: Yes, a player may return to the starting position
quiz.passBlocked: No, a turn cannot end without changing the position

about.title: About this edition
about.body: This product follows the official standard two-player Arimaa rules. It uses original board marks, piece glyphs, and tutorial wording.

online.title: Private online rooms
online.body: Invite another player with a short room code. The dedicated game service validates every complete turn.
online.coming: Online rooms are being prepared for the private Melon stage.
online.noChat: No chat is available in this game.

errors.invalidSave: The saved game could not be restored.
errors.botFallback: The bot service did not respond. A seeded legal move was used.
